# SPO_CS/src – Module Overview

A quick reference for each m*.cs file in this directory.

For shared utility modules, see [Common/llms.txt](Common/llms.txt).

## Core Compiler & VM

- mIL_AST.cs
  - Defines the intermediate‑language AST nodes and command structures.
- mIL_GenerateOpcodes.cs
  - Converts IL AST to VM opcodes; tests verify opcode generation.
- mIL_Parser.cs
  - Parses IL text into IL AST structures.
- mTokenizer.cs
  - Tokenizer turning raw text into tokens for both SPO and IL parsers.
- mVM_Data.cs
  - Opcode enumeration and runtime data representations.
- mVM_Type.cs
  - VM type system (kinds, constructors, unification helpers).
- mVM.cs
  - Stack‑based virtual machine executing opcode streams.

## SPO Language Front‑End

- mSPO_AST.cs
  - Abstract syntax tree for the SPO language.
- mSPO_AST_Types.cs
  - Type inference and relationship logic over SPO AST.
- mSPO_Parser.cs
  - Parser from tokens to SPO AST.
- mSPO2IL.cs
  - Compiler: SPO AST → IL.
- mSPO_Interpreter.cs
  - Orchestrates parsing, type analysis, IL generation, and VM execution.
- mStdLib.cs
  - Loads and exercises the standard library.
- mSPO.Tests.cs
  - Aggregates individual SPO module tests into a single suite.

## Miscellaneous

- mRunTests.cs – Entry point that collects and runs all tests across modules.
